request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real food, glass, ceramic and fabric texture, soft natural daylight and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

Image 1 shows Luis: about thirty, short curly black hair, a navy T-shirt. Keep his face, hair and clothes exactly. Create a NEW photograph: Luis stands at a café counter and points with one finger at ONE sandwich on a plain white plate that stands alone on the counter in front of him, looking at it with a hungry, eager smile: he clearly WANTS that sandwich. He is seen from the waist up; his face, his pointing hand and the sandwich are sharp. Exactly one person; no other food on the counter, no menu board, no price signs. No letters, words, numbers, logos, labels or brand marks anywhere. Every visible hand has five natural fingers.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-09-24; before tax, not an invoice.
